fields.title: Spotify curator record
fields.description: Dataset envelope (_input / _source / _scrapedAt / recordType) on top of Spotify's playlist and owner data, plus taste metrics derived from the tracks each curator selected. One CURATOR row per owner, one PLAYLIST row per playlist, ERROR rows on failure. Spotify adds and removes fields without notice, so unlisted fields pass through rather than failing the run.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The keyword or URL that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: pathfinder-searchSuggestions, pathfinder-fetchPlaylist, or none on failure rows.

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was emitted.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Failure rows only: search_failed, not_found, unparsable_input or fetch_failed.

ownerName.title: Curator
ownerName.description: Display name of the account that owns the playlists.

ownerId.title: Curator id
ownerId.description: Spotify user id - the stable handle that appears in profile links, and the key curators are grouped on.

ownerSocialHandle.title: Social handle
ownerSocialHandle.description: Handle the curator has attached to their Spotify profile, when they set one.

isEditorial.title: Spotify editorial
isEditorial.description: True when the owner is Spotify's own editorial account rather than an independent curator.

playlistsFound.title: Playlists found
playlistsFound.description: How many of this curator's playlists this run profiled. It is what the run discovered, not their full catalogue - Spotify does not expose a public list of a user's playlists.

totalFollowers.title: Total followers
totalFollowers.description: Followers summed across the playlists found. The headline reach number.

reach.title: Reach
reach.description: Same as totalFollowers, present on every row so curators sort cleanly even when follower data is missing.

maxPlaylistFollowers.title: Largest playlist followers
maxPlaylistFollowers.description: Followers on their single biggest playlist found.

totalTracksCurated.title: Tracks curated
totalTracksCurated.description: Combined track count across the playlists found.

biggestPlaylistName.title: Biggest playlist
biggestPlaylistName.description: The playlist with the most followers.

playlistNames.title: Playlist names
playlistNames.description: Every playlist of theirs this run profiled.

playlistUrls.title: Playlist URLs
playlistUrls.description: Links to each of those playlists.

lastUpdated.title: Last updated
lastUpdated.description: Most recent update timestamp across their playlists, when Spotify publishes one. Tells you whether the curator is still active.

topArtists.title: Top artists
topArtists.description: Artists appearing most often across the sampled tracks, with a count each.

topArtistNames.title: Top artist names
topArtistNames.description: Just the names, for quick scanning and filtering.

distinctArtists.title: Distinct artists
distinctArtists.description: How many different artists appear in the sample. A low number against a large sample means a repetitive playlist.

trackSample.title: Tracks sampled
trackSample.description: How many tracks the taste metrics were computed from.

medianPlaycount.title: Median play count
medianPlaycount.description: Median lifetime streams across the sampled tracks. Spotify's official API publishes no equivalent figure.

maxPlaycount.title: Highest play count
maxPlaycount.description: The most-streamed track in the sample.

undergroundScore.title: Underground score
undergroundScore.description: 0 to 1, derived from the median play count. Near 1 means the curator mostly picks little-heard recordings; near 0 means they play established hits. A low median beside a high maximum is the signature of a discovery curator with one or two anchor tracks.

oldestReleaseYear.title: Oldest release year
oldestReleaseYear.description: Earliest release year in the sample.

newestReleaseYear.title: Newest release year
newestReleaseYear.description: Latest release year in the sample.

catalogueSpreadYears.title: Catalogue spread
catalogueSpreadYears.description: Years between the oldest and newest release. A wide spread means a retrospective selection; a narrow one means a new-music curator.

explicitShare.title: Explicit share
explicitShare.description: Fraction of sampled tracks Spotify labels explicit, 0 to 1.

description.title: Playlist description
description.description: PLAYLIST rows: the curator's own description, HTML stripped. Often where submission instructions or contact details are.

followers.title: Followers
followers.description: PLAYLIST rows: accounts following this playlist.

trackCount.title: Tracks
trackCount.description: PLAYLIST rows: total tracks in the playlist, which can exceed the sample.

coverArt.title: Cover art
coverArt.description: PLAYLIST rows: largest cover image Spotify offers.

foundVia.title: Found via
foundVia.description: PLAYLIST rows: the keyword that surfaced this playlist, or 'input' when it was supplied directly.
